clara-whitmore.name: Clara Whitmore
bio: Placeholder biography. Clara Whitmore has appeared as soloist and chamber musician across North America and Europe, and is a founding member of a string quartet known for its performances of *Haydn* and of living composers.
She teaches privately and at summer programs, and plays a violin made in Cremona in 1780.

julien-arsenault.name: Julien Arsenault
bio: Placeholder biography. Born in Acadian Nova Scotia, Julien Arsenault returns home each autumn from a career that has taken him to concert halls on three continents.

maren-holt.name: Maren Holt
bio: Placeholder biography. Maren Holt is a violist and chamber musician whose work moves between the standard repertoire, new commissions and historical performance.

thomas-ebright.name: Thomas Ebright
bio: Placeholder biography. Thomas Ebright is principal cellist of a regional orchestra and a frequent guest at chamber music festivals.

isabelle-leblanc.name: Isabelle LeBlanc
bio: Placeholder biography. Isabelle LeBlanc is a pianist with a particular love for the song and chamber repertoire, and has recorded the complete piano trios of Fanny Mendelssohn.

owen-macleod.name: Owen MacLeod
bio: Placeholder biography. Owen MacLeod is a classical guitarist and arranger whose arrangements of traditional Maritime tunes are a festival favourite.

nadia-roy.name: Nadia Roy
bio: Placeholder biography. Nadia Roy performs as a soloist and chamber musician and has premiered more than thirty works for clarinet.
